operational_definition: Inflation-adjusted disposable household resources over a predeclared interval
possible_data_source: Official income survey or consented administrative data
main_limitations: Household size, informal activity, underreporting and local prices

operational_definition: Households unable to meet a locally defined unexpected essential expense
possible_data_source: Lawful validated survey question
main_limitations: Subjective threshold and contextual comparability

operational_definition: Households exposed to a specified income shock over a defined follow-up
possible_data_source: Official household survey or consented interview
main_limitations: Recall and selection bias; no causal attribution alone

operational_definition: Proportion of lawfully verified eligible participants actually receiving the specified benefit within the observation window
possible_data_source: Partner administrative receipt confirmation where legally permitted
main_limitations: Eligibility definition, missing records and private data safeguards

operational_definition: Time between eligibility-confirmed engagement and verified benefit receipt
possible_data_source: Auditable administrative event intervals
main_limitations: May be distorted by differing application dates and delays

operational_definition: Specified essential energy cost as a share of household disposable resources adjusted for context
possible_data_source: Consented bill records with lawful household income estimate
main_limitations: Seasonality, climate, price spikes and burden thresholds

operational_definition: Households reporting inability to maintain locally adequate thermal comfort
possible_data_source: Validated local survey
main_limitations: Seasonality and self-report differences

operational_definition: Households meeting a locally validated food access/security measure
possible_data_source: Public health or validated household survey
main_limitations: Sensitivity, recall and comparability

operational_definition: Self-reported health or wellbeing using an appropriate validated and consented instrument
possible_data_source: Locally validated survey
main_limitations: Language adaptations, sensitive data and attribution

operational_definition: Educational attendance in an explicitly defined eligible cohort
possible_data_source: Legitimate school administrative aggregation or validated survey
main_limitations: Age/cohort specificity and privacy safeguards

operational_definition: Reported ability to access a specified essential health service in time
possible_data_source: Validated local survey or provider aggregate
main_limitations: Access measure is not necessarily health improvement

operational_definition: Sustained inflation-adjusted personal earnings at prespecified follow-up
possible_data_source: Lawful payroll/admin data or validated survey
main_limitations: Informal work, attrition, job quality and spillovers

operational_definition: Employment maintained for a prespecified period with minimum job-quality safeguards
possible_data_source: Consented employer records or validated survey
main_limitations: Displacement, labour market seasonality, precarity

operational_definition: Participants who completed an offered course or training activity
possible_data_source: Programme operational log
main_limitations: Not evidence of increased employment or earnings

operational_definition: Autonomy over a defined life decision measured with culturally validated questions
possible_data_source: Consented validated survey
main_limitations: Cultural differences, coercion and instrument validity

operational_definition: People reporting safety in a clearly specified context and time window
possible_data_source: Consented validated survey
main_limitations: Safety sensitivity, recall and participant risk

operational_definition: Incremental local environmental burden or savings attributable to programme delivery
possible_data_source: Partner lifecycle or audited operational data
main_limitations: System boundaries and double counting

operational_definition: People contacted, invited or reached through communications
possible_data_source: Programme logs limited to aggregates
main_limitations: Reach is not eligibility, take-up or improved wellbeing

operational_definition: Total programme delivery cost within a predefined perspective
possible_data_source: Audited programme finance records
main_limitations: Missing overhead and participant time costs

operational_definition: Predefined adverse outcomes with approved reporting route
possible_data_source: Independent safeguarding monitoring
main_limitations: Underreporting; do not publish identifiable details
